body:
## Summary
The `link_assistant_router` library crate does not expose a large part of Router's operational logic. In v1.16.0 these modules are declared only in the `router` binary (`src/main.rs`): `deploy_cli`, `deploy_local` (20 files, about 6.4k lines: host mode, staging, relay rotation, checkpoints and restore, service install, registry), `deploy_remote`, `auth_cli`, `auth_import`, `logs_cli`, `bin_doctor`, `recover_admin_cli`, `shutdown`.

As a result, even a Rust downstream cannot import local or remote deployment, host-mode migration, staging, checkpoint/restore, auth import, log reading, doctor or admin recovery. It can only spawn the binary. Other library modules (`deploy`, `deploy_config`, `tunnel_command`, `with_command`, `verification_client`, …) are public, but many of them print and return exit codes rather than structured results.

## Proposal
1. Move the operational logic into the library behind a documented public API: `deploy::local::{plan, apply, status}`, `deploy::remote::*`, `deploy::host::*`, `deploy::staging::*`, `deploy::checkpoint::{capture, restore}`, `auth::import`, `logs::read`, `doctor::report`, `admin::recover`, `verification::run(areas)` (the logic now in `scripts/verify-contracts.rs`). The binaries become thin adapters that parse arguments and render output.
2. Library functions return typed results and errors (the same data the `--json` output carries). They never print, never call `exit`, and take their environment, clock, process runner and filesystem roots as parameters, so callers and tests can inject them.
3. Publish rustdoc for the public API on docs.rs, with an example per operation (extend `examples/`).
4. Add `cargo-semver-checks` to CI, so breaking the library API needs a major version or an explicit, documented exception. Downstreams can then pin with confidence.

## Acceptance
- Every operation the `router` CLI performs can be done from Rust through the library, with no `std::process::Command` on the router binary.
- `src/main.rs` declares no module that contains operational logic.
- A semver check runs on every PR.
title: Library completeness: deploy, host mode, staging, checkpoints, auth import, logs, doctor and verification are binary-only and cannot be imported
